m_17fe97d7aa2f5332.text: The threat of Climate Change is exaggerated.
m_17fe97d7aa2f5332.quote: The threat of Climate Change is exaggerated

m_90c95d8967117c70.text: According to The Center For Biological Diversity, the world's climate is changing as a result of the burning of fossil fuels.
m_90c95d8967117c70.quote: According to The Center For Biological Diversity , the world's climate is changing as a result of the burning of fossil fuels.
qualifiers: According to The Center For Biological Diversity

m_2cfdb9d389feed7e.text: The burning of fossil fuels creates carbon dioxide.
m_2cfdb9d389feed7e.quote: The burning of fossil fuels creates carbon dioxide.

m_d02e2d104698015d.text: Carbon dioxide traps heat in the atmosphere.
m_d02e2d104698015d.quote: Carbon dioxide traps heat in the atmosphere

m_b260742908c99e91.text: Carbon dioxide trapping heat in the atmosphere causes the world's temperature to rise.
m_b260742908c99e91.quote: Carbon dioxide traps heat in the atmosphere, and this causes the world's temperature to rise.

m_82837c07e8096b8d.text: The rise in the world's temperature is likely to reduce the amount of arable land on Earth.
m_82837c07e8096b8d.quote: This is likely to reduce the amount of arable land on Earth

m_a7ff56cc0682d320.text: The rise in the world's temperature will cause food prices to increase.
m_a7ff56cc0682d320.quote: it will cause food prices to increase

m_80b57e87e843bd56.text: Climate change is likely to result in rising sea levels.
m_80b57e87e843bd56.quote: climate change is likely to result in rising sea levels

m_ae2eecc3bfc94c7b.text: There are major cities that could be flooded.
m_ae2eecc3bfc94c7b.quote: There even are major cities that could be flooded.

m_ae84be193830bfb7.text: The production of fossil fuels will increase as the population increases.
m_ae84be193830bfb7.quote: As the population increases, the production of fossil fuels will increase.

m_5244c3cc8db20998.text: The increase in the production of fossil fuels is likely to result in climate change occurring at an increasingly rapid pace.
m_5244c3cc8db20998.quote: This is likely to result in climate change occurring at an increasingly rapid pace.

m_bebce377b68a3fb0.text: The sun is the driving force of Earth's climate.
m_bebce377b68a3fb0.quote: It is the sun that is the driving force of our climate

m_0e3c5090d140ba59.text: The sun has the biggest impact on Earth's climate rather than anything that humans might be doing.
m_0e3c5090d140ba59.quote: it has the biggest impact on our climate rather than anything that humans might be doing

m_c4e46cb80f7da86a.text: The sun is the most likely cause of global warming.
m_c4e46cb80f7da86a.quote: The sun is therefore the most likely cause of global warming.

m_2d7853f70456d241.text: Henrik Svensmark is a physicist at the Danish National Space Center in Copenhagen.
m_2d7853f70456d241.quote: a physicist at the Danish National Space Center in Copenhagen

m_a2a2318761d12aa7.text: Henrik Svensmark argues that climate change is caused by solar activity.
m_a2a2318761d12aa7.quote: argues that climate change is caused by solar activity

m_3fe714fef9f4709e.text: Solar activity could affect climate by variation in the Sun's output.
m_3fe714fef9f4709e.quote: Solar activity could affect climate by variation in the Sun's output

m_a0ffa61c93bc78f8.text: Solar activity could affect climate through having an effect on cloud formation.
m_a0ffa61c93bc78f8.quote: potentially through having an effect on cloud formation

m_ed97971e509cb240.text: Sunspot numbers show correlations and anti-correlations with a number of reconstructions of the terrestrial Northern Hemisphere temperature.
m_ed97971e509cb240.quote: Sunspot numbers and cosmic ray fluxes... show correlations and anti-correlations with a number of reconstructions of the terrestrial Northern Hemisphere temperature

m_4b78a81f400b44b6.text: Cosmic ray fluxes show correlations and anti-correlations with a number of reconstructions of the terrestrial Northern Hemisphere temperature.
m_4b78a81f400b44b6.quote: Sunspot numbers and cosmic ray fluxes... show correlations and anti-correlations with a number of reconstructions of the terrestrial Northern Hemisphere temperature

m_c9e529e1e7e5b1c8.text: The reconstructions of the terrestrial Northern Hemisphere temperature cover a time span of up to 1800 years.
m_c9e529e1e7e5b1c8.quote: which cover a time span of up to 1800 years

m_240570da6a21a8a9.text: Periods of higher solar activity tend to be associated with warmer climate.
m_240570da6a21a8a9.quote: periods of higher solar activity and lower cosmic ray flux tend to be associated with warmer climate

m_2c7f06cf8b3a9252.text: Periods of lower cosmic ray flux tend to be associated with warmer climate.
m_2c7f06cf8b3a9252.quote: periods of higher solar activity and lower cosmic ray flux tend to be associated with warmer climate

m_771fe5b58824246e.text: Effects induced by cosmic rays may affect the long-term terrestrial climate.
m_771fe5b58824246e.quote: effects induced by cosmic rays may affect the long-term terrestrial climate

m_960c9710d20ea9f8.text: The positive correlation between the geomagnetic dipole moment and the temperature reconstructions provides further evidence favoring the cosmic ray influence on the terrestrial climate.
m_960c9710d20ea9f8.quote: The positive correlation between the geomagnetic dipole moment and the temperature reconstructions provides further evidence favoring the cosmic ray influence on the terrestrial climate.

m_9d8c4b988cf83b11.text: Over the past 10,000 years, solar minima have been accompanied by sharp climate changes.
m_9d8c4b988cf83b11.quote: Over the past 10,000 years, solar minima (reduced sun spot activity) have been "accompanied by sharp climate changes."

m_0bdd66df2d85463a.text: Solar minima are reduced sun spot activity.

m_7d3679c791ade735.text: The increase in solar irradiance between 1900 and 2000 correlated with the rise in US surface temperatures over the 20th century.
m_7d3679c791ade735.quote: correlated with the rise in US surface temperatures over the 20th century

m_2a2eb39444c8601b.text: A 2007 study found that variations in solar activity are the direct cause of the observed multiyear variations in climatic responses.
m_2a2eb39444c8601b.quote: "variations in solar activity and not the burning of fossil fuels are the direct cause of the observed multiyear variations in climatic responses."

m_5cf3fa7fb5e80158.text: A 2007 study found that the burning of fossil fuels is not the direct cause of the observed multiyear variations in climatic responses.
m_5cf3fa7fb5e80158.quote: "variations in solar activity and not the burning of fossil fuels are the direct cause of the observed multiyear variations in climatic responses."

m_995beba0b3e3bff3.text: Willie Soon is a physicist at the Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics.
m_995beba0b3e3bff3.quote: Willie Soon, PhD, Physicist at the Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics

m_bc81955aa9fc99f4.text: A 2012 study by Willie Soon identified a strong correlation between solar radiation and temperatures in the Arctic over the past 130 years.
m_bc81955aa9fc99f4.quote: In a 2012 study by Willie Soon, PhD, Physicist at the Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics, a strong correlation between solar radiation and temperatures in the Arctic over the past 130 years was identified.

m_44155a68d1687d36.text: According to a 2012 study, up to 70% of the observed post-1850 climate change and warming could be associated to multiple solar cycles.
m_44155a68d1687d36.quote: "up to 70% of the observed post-1850 climate change and warming could be associated to multiple solar cycles."
